evidence.name: Screen field: Color the restore link text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color the restore link text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color the restore link text
sections.description: Sets the restore link's text color (default a muted gray). Check it against your header background first — that gray default disappears on a dark hero, so use a lighter tint there. Keep it readable but understated so restore reads as a secondary link, with enough contrast to stay accessible.
